[b]Official Joint Communique of the Government of Baladullah, Patriarchate of the Syriac Orthodox Church of Baladullah, and Ministry of Defense[/b]

The re-establishment of various Christian extremist states in West Shamat, including some bordering Baladullah, is a massively destabilizing and possibly destructive political development that threatens the sovereignty, peace, and stability of all of West Shamat. The Holy City of Jerusalem is rightfully under the sovereignty of ULR, and they are properly protecting its sanctity and people. 

The vast majority of people on West Shamat are Muslims, the very group the Crusader ideology hates the most and the very group they sought to conquer and destroy during the Crusades. There is also a significant Jewish population on West Shamat, and they too are a possible target of the Crusader states. Even other Christian groups are not safe if they do not ally themselves with these extremists.

 The Syriac Orthodox Church of Baladullah wholeheartedly rejects the Crusader ideology, and firmly stands in solidarity with the rest of Baladullah and the rest of the indigenous peoples of West Shamat. Jesus (peace be upon him) taught us that the peacemakers are blessed, to love our enemies, and not to be aggressive with people. How can these teachings exist alongside violent extremism and intolerance?

As it stands, we are mobilizing millions of fighters to defend our sovereignty if the need arises, and implementing a massive shift in manufacturing and information technology systems from peace time activities to war preparedness. We hoped such a day would never come, but also have the capacity and capabilities to withstand it, in shaa Allah. This means:
3 million mujahideen now prepped and ready for war on top of our regular ground forces
10,000 drones, some of them kamikaze drones, some with light arms, some with loaded charges
Activation of our SAM systems throughout the entire country, and opening of 100,000 underground reinforced shelters in the most populous areas of the country
All civil defense and security forces on the highest alert, especially in the border regions
Closing of our borders with the Crusader states and moving 100,000 troops with light and heavy arms to the vulnerable areas on these borders

We do not seek war, but if we have to fight, we will fight knowing the outcome is one of the two best things: victory or martyrdom. 

Hasbun Allah wa niam wakeel (Allah is sufficient for us and He is the Best Protector)

[i]Mahmoud ibn al-Arabiyya

[quote=the_crystalline_empire;61219459][b]October 8, 2027: The National Readiness Plan[/b]

The government of Rosenmarkke has formally announced that the state shall be undergoing a Mass Mobilization with the current international tensions requiring a new national mindset. 

Under the NRP or National Readiness Plan which was released a week prior to the grand assembly and the general public, the government would require 30% of all industrial output to be shifted towards R&D and civil-military expansion, under this framework factories and industrial complexes would be partially nationalised and begin rolling 24-hour shifts. The plan would also order that 20% of all railway capacity be immediately transferred to military usage.

Furthermore, the state would announce a new tranche of nationalisations which would affect primarily the farming industry, with 5-6% of all farms being placed under state management within the Department of Agriculture.

Schools and universities further would be mandated to add military defense and training classes to their curriculum prioritizing warfighting and defense readiness over standard academics ehich would be wrapped into the military education by the second quarter of 2028.

The National Civil Aviation Administration would be ordered to surrender its operations to the government to be split between the Air force and Army commands. 

In a comment about the plan Strømm is cited as saying: Readiness is sacred, strength is essential, and power is non-negotiable,
[/quote]
